item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q020_syntaxin_fragment_reclassification","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d1br0a_, d1ez3a_, d1ez3b_, d1ez3c_, and the full-domain record d1dn1b_ are all classified as a.47.2.1: class a (all-alpha), fold a.47 (STAT-like), superfamily a.47.2 (t-SNARE proteins), and family a.47.2.1 (t-SNARE proteins). The early 1br0/1ez3 records are explicitly annotated as three-helical fragments resembling one spectrin repeat and as missing secondary structure. Thus their spectrin-like appearance should be treated as local substructure resemblance, not evidence for a spectrin-repeat fold or spectrin homology. Full-domain context supersedes that fragment-based inference and places them in the syntaxin/t-SNARE lineage. Fold agreement alone would not establish ancestry; common superfamily supports probable homology, while common family is stronger evidence of close evolutionary relationship. Even within that family, identical function, conformational state, interaction partners, or exact domain boundaries should not be transferred automatically. For modeling, the fragments are suitable only as local templates over their covered helices, not as representatives of the complete topology. Prefer a complete-domain record: SCOPe marks d1dn1b_ as an automated match to d3c98b_, the revised full-chain structure, whereas d3c98b_ has no missing-structure inconsistency. A fragment should likewise not be selected as the family representative merely because it has better local similarity.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3c98/domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_/homology"]}]}
